The '''Spine Snake River''' was a river located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG" /> It was used as a racetrack for the [[Lok Marathon]].<ref name="SWG:LM">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Swoop race track: "Lok Marathon" on Lok</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Spine Snake River first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Its name was revealed during the Lok Marathon swoop race.<ref name="SWG:LM" />
